name: 3S Stepper
author: Joakim
description: Area bot: walks a recorded route, kills the mobs it meets, and records new routes as you walk them. Port of ThreeS_Stepper. Reads the room and its contents from GMCP, so the MUD's '=S=', '=M=' and '=P=' display markers are no longer needed; those triggers remain as a fallback for a character or MUD without GMCP, each standing down for any room GMCP has already described.
